tools.name: biggest_bets_today
tools.description: The 10 largest bets in the last 24 hours on Kalshi or Polymarket: market, side, price, size, and the trader's record. No sign-in needed. Cached; for the live feed, sign in.

tools.name: top_traders
tools.description: The 10 top prediction market traders by tracked profit, on Kalshi, Polymarket or both, with their win and loss record. Market makers are labelled. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: trader_record
tools.description: One trader's tracked record on Kalshi or Polymarket: wins, losses, profit and their latest trades. Pass `trader` as top_traders and biggest_bets_today return it: the name on Kalshi, the wallet address on Polymarket. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: game_bets
tools.description: This week's NFL, NBA or college football games on Kalshi: each side's price, how many proven traders back it, and the sides with the most money. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: market_odds
tools.description: One major market's odds on every venue that lists it (Super Bowl, World Series, Fed decision, Senate races and more): each outcome's price per venue and the cheapest place to buy. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: get_trades
tools.description: Large trades on the venues, newest first, reaching back 30 days. Answers "what are whales buying". Each row names the market (with its ref), the side, price, dollars and, where the venue names traders, the trader with their record. Every row older than an hour counts toward the account's 5,000 trade

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Open positions of traders with a winning record, biggest first: the market, the side, what they paid, what it costs now, the lead holder and the others. The best answer to "what are winning traders holding". Each holder counts as one row toward the 5,000 trades a day.

tools.name: get_moves
tools.description: Sharp price moves, favorite flips and whales piling into one side, over the last day, newest first. Use since to see only what is new since your last call.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Markets by name or by activity: open (default), settled in the last 30 days, or all. Returns each market's ref, title, venue, outcomes with prices, and whale money in the last hour. Use the ref with get_market, get_trades or place_paper_order.

tools.description: Traders ranked by profit, win rate, return, volume, trades or recent activity, overall or within a category, kind of market or period. The top 100 for any ranking. Each call counts toward the account's 10 trader listings a day.

tools.name: place_paper_order
tools.description: Buy or sell one side of a market on paper, at the venue's live price including its fee. No money moves. tools.name: get_paper_account
tools.description: The account's paper positions (open by default), placed by hand and by bots, with profit. include orders adds the hand-placed orders.

tools.name: list_bots
tools.description: The account's bots of all three kinds (trader, signal, market), each with its record. Bots made in the app and through the API are listed together. A live bot (mode live) is counted from its real orders on the venue. Archived bots are left out unless archived is true, which lists only them.

tools.description: One bot by id: its settings, status and record. include trades adds its trades (last 30 days, counted as rows; each carries the bot's rule when it made it, as saved then); activity adds how often its trigger fires. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v2" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_bot_audit · Private data: biggest_bets_today, top_traders, trader_record, get_trades, get_positions, get_trader, list_bots, get_bot, get_bot_audit, update_bot, delete_bot · Public sink: get_trader, backtest, update_bot · Destructive: update_bot, delete_bot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_bot_audit · Private data: biggest_bets_today, top_traders, trader_record, get_trades, get_positions, get_trader, list_bots, get_bot, get_bot_audit, update_bot, delete_bot · Public sink: get_trader, backtest, update_bot · Destructive: update_bot, delete_bot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
